about: Lethbridge is in southern Alberta, in a coulee landscape cut by the Oldman River. It is a commercial and university city for irrigation farm country, with frequent chinook winds and views of the Rockies on clear days. A high-level railway trestle spans the river valley above Indian Battle Park. About 98,000 people live in Lethbridge.
seoSummary: Southern Alberta city in the Oldman River coulees, a service centre for irrigation country.
knownFor: Oldman River coulees and the High Level Bridge
University of Lethbridge on the west valley rim
Irrigation agriculture and a dry prairie climate
Chinook winds and mountain views to the west
